validate_protobuf_runtime_version: validate protobuf gencode version compatibility against the current runtime version
check_version_error: raise a VersionError exception when protobuf gencode and runtime versions are incompatible
inspect_domain_enum: inspect the Domain enum to check GOOGLE_INTERNAL or PUBLIC protobuf domain values
read_runtime_version_constants: read the MAJOR, MINOR, PATCH, and SUFFIX constants for the current protobuf runtime version
disable_version_check_env: set the TEMPORARILY_DISABLE_PROTOBUF_VERSION_CHECK environment variable to skip version validation
